abstract: As an emerging regulatory instrument, green standard-setting has become an integral component of the contemporary environmental governance framework. However, empirical evidence regarding its microeconomic effects remains limited. Constructing a novel measure of green standards via classification codes and measuring industry exposure through natural language processing techniques, we investigate the impact of green standards on corporate green innovation using a panel of Chinese A-share listed firms from 2007 to 2024. We document a positive and significant relationship between green standards and corporate green innovation. Mechanism analyses suggest that compliance cost constraints, technological trajectory guidance, and green signalling serve as the key channels. Furthermore, our evidence alleviates concerns about strategic innovation catering, and suggests that green standards are associated with substantive green innovation. Heterogeneity analyses show stronger responses among non-SOEs, firms with overseas-experienced CEOs, digitally transformed firms, heavily polluting firms, and firms in regions with stricter environmental regulation and stronger intellectual property protection. Overall, our findings offer novel insights into the literature on environmental policy instruments and yield practical implications for optimizing the environmental governance system. KEYWORDS: Green standards green innovation compliance pressure knowledge spillovers signal transmission JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q55 Q58 G38
abstract_zh: 作为一种新兴的规制工具，绿色标准制定已成为当代环境治理框架中不可或缺的组成部分。然而，关于其微观经济效应的经验证据仍然有限。本文通过分类代码构建了一种新的绿色标准衡量指标，并运用自然语言处理技术测度行业暴露程度，基于2007年至2024年中国A股上市公司面板数据，考察绿色标准对企业绿色创新的影响。研究发现，绿色标准与企业绿色创新之间存在显著的正向关系。机制分析表明，合规成本约束、技术轨迹引导和绿色信号传递是主要渠道。此外，本文的证据缓解了关于策略性创新迎合的担忧，并表明绿色标准与实质性绿色创新相关。异质性分析显示，在非国有企业、拥有海外经历CEO的企业、数字化转型企业、重污染企业以及环境规制更严格、知识产权保护更强地区的企业中，上述效应更为显著。总体而言，本文的发现为环境政策工具文献提供了新的见解，并为优化环境治理体系提供了实践启示。关键词：绿色标准 绿色创新 合规压力 知识溢出 信号传递 JEL分类：Q55 Q58 G38

title: Catalyst or compliance burden: the effects of green standard formulation on corporate green innovation

abstract: Water markets are widely recognised for enhancing the efficient use and redistribution of water, with the southern Murray‐Darling Basin (MDB) in Australia considered the most advanced water market worldwide. This study applies a Dynamic Conditional Correlation Generalised Autoregressive Conditional Heteroskedasticity (DCC‐GARCH) model to provide a long‐run assessment of MDB water entitlements as financial assets, evaluating their value, hedging capacity and safe‐haven potential relative to national investment portfolios. We use monthly water trade data (from 1993 to 2025) from one of the longest operating irrigation water areas in the MDB, the Goulburn‐Murray Irrigation District. Investing in permanent water entitlements over this time period exhibited strong returns of around 20%, surpassing, on average, the Australian stock market and real estate investment options, although these returns fluctuate in line with various cycles. The results suggest that water entitlements act as a hedge against equity, forex and urban real estate markets, with this hedging role strengthening markedly after the 2007 water unbundling reform. Water entitlements also provide safe‐haven benefits to owners during financial market turmoil, particularly compared to the stock market. The findings are consistent with the existing literature, indicating that the Australian water market is becoming more liquid, more widely used and increasingly heterogeneous.
abstract_zh: 水市场因提升水资源的高效利用与再分配而广受认可，其中澳大利亚南部墨累—达令盆地（MDB）被视为全球最先进的水市场。本研究运用动态条件相关广义自回归条件异方差（DCC‐GARCH）模型，对MDB水权作为一种金融资产进行长期评估，考察其相对于国家投资组合的价值、对冲能力以及避险潜力。我们使用来自MDB运营时间最长的灌溉水区之一——古尔本—墨累灌溉区——1993年至2025年的月度水交易数据。在此期间，投资永久水权表现出约20%的强劲回报，平均而言超过澳大利亚股票市场和房地产投资选择，尽管这些回报会随各种周期而波动。结果表明，水权可作为对股票、外汇和城市房地产市场的对冲工具，且这一对冲作用在2007年水权拆分改革后显著增强。水权还在金融市场动荡期间为持有者提供避险收益，尤其是相对于股票市场而言。这些发现与现有文献一致，表明澳大利亚水市场正变得更具流动性、更广泛使用且日益异质化。
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: How Does the Value of Investing in Australian Water Entitlements Compare to Other Investments Over Time?
title_zh: 投资澳大利亚水权与其他投资的价值随时间变化比较如何？

abstract: This study evaluates equity analysts’ earnings forecasts, comparing United States (U.S.) sugar‐using firms (SUF), and a selected group of agribusinesses (AGB). Aspects of U.S. sugar policy, reinitiated in 1982, help to ensure a reliable and predictable domestic supply of SUF's primary ingredient, sugar. U.S. sugar policy requires the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) to generate publicly available sugar supply and demand forecasts through its World Agriculture Supply and Demand Estimates ( WASDE ) report, introduced in 1992 and expanded in 2008 to include Mexican sugar forecasts. Therefore, we examined whether the reinitiation of U.S. sugar policy, the initiation of WASDE sugar forecasts, and the implementation of the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA) for sugar trade benefited SUF by improving equity analysts’ earnings per share (EPS) forecasting accuracy for these firms. This analysis, mainly based on difference‐in‐differences and event‐study regression, focused on EPS forecast accuracy from 1976 to 2025. Consistent with our hypothesis, we found that improvements in SUF EPS forecast accuracy were statistically associated with the reinitiation of U.S. sugar policy in 1982 and, to a lesser extent, with the implementation of the NAFTA sugar provision in 2008. More broadly, our analysis suggests that, given its role as a price‐ and supply‐stabilizer, U.S. sugar policy might have caused a structural shift in the U.S. sugar industry, providing a more predictable business environment, and that its legacy may remain present in the contemporary forecasting environment.
abstract_zh: 本研究评估了股票分析师的盈利预测，比较了美国（U.S.）用糖企业（SUF）与一组精选的农业综合企业（AGB）。美国糖业政策于1982年重新启动，其诸多方面有助于确保SUF主要原料——糖——的国内供应可靠且可预测。美国糖业政策要求美国农业部（USDA）通过其《世界农业供需估计》（WASDE）报告生成公开可得的糖供需预测，该报告于1992年推出，并于2008年扩展至纳入墨西哥糖预测。因此，我们考察了美国糖业政策的重新启动、WASDE糖预测的启动以及《北美自由贸易协定》（NAFTA）糖贸易条款的实施，是否通过提高股票分析师对这些企业每股收益（EPS）的预测准确性而使SUF受益。本分析主要基于双重差分法和事件研究回归，聚焦于1976年至2025年间的EPS预测准确性。与我们的假设一致，我们发现SUF的EPS预测准确性提升在统计上与1982年美国糖业政策的重新启动相关，并在较小程度上与2008年NAFTA糖条款的实施相关。更广泛地说，我们的分析表明，鉴于美国糖业政策作为价格和供应稳定器的作用，它可能引发了美国糖业的结构性转变，提供了更可预测的经营环境，并且其影响可能仍存在于当代的预测环境中。
title: The Accuracy of Equity Analysts’ Earnings Per Share Forecasts of Agribusinesses and Sugar‐Using Firms
title_zh: 农业综合企业和用糖企业股票分析师每股收益预测的准确性

abstract: I study a product differentiation model with endogenous entry where a politically connected public firm competes with a private one. Consumers are heterogeneous in their willingness to pay. I argue that—because of political ties—the public firm may mimic the preferences of the consumer with the median willingness to pay. I show that as privatization (i.e., the weight on profits in the public firm's objective function) increases, the equilibrium market structure shifts from a welfare‐inefficient public monopoly to a duopoly. Under duopoly, the public firm can set a relatively low price to attract and please the median consumer. In this way, the public firm gains market shares and, consequently, market power. In equilibrium, the public firm can then end up being more profitable than its private, profit‐seeking competitor. Finally, I show that full privatization is not socially optimal.
title: Privatization Under Political Ties
title_zh: 政治关系下的私有化

abstract: Using panel data of 83 Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) countries from 2005 to 2023, we investigate the convergence dynamics of energy poverty to determine whether countries are escaping the energy poverty trap and the role of China's outward foreign direct investment (OFDI) in the convergence process. We find that while traditional convergence tests confirm a catch-up effect, the Phillips-Sul club convergence model identifies five distinct clubs among BRI countries: 1) severe energy poverty trap; 2) high energy poverty with slow convergence; 3) medium energy poverty with sluggish improvement; 4) low energy poverty with steady progress; 5) lowest energy poverty frontier with the fastest convergence. Furthermore, China's OFDI in infrastructure and economic growth sectors within BRI countries promotes the formation of lower energy poverty convergence clubs. Infrastructure-oriented OFDI is particularly effective in the most severe and the least energy poverty clubs, while market-oriented OFDI demonstrates a more consistent and widespread effect across all clubs. Differentiated strategies and strengthened multilateral coordination are essential to maximize poverty reduction outcomes.

abstract: This paper introduces a new approach for bubble detection based on mixed causal and noncausal autoregressive processes and their tail process representation during an explosive episode. Departing from traditional definitions of bubbles as nonstationary and temporarily explosive processes, we adopt a perspective in which prices are assumed to follow a strictly stationary process, with the bubble considered an intrinsic component of its nonlinear dynamics. The proposed approach provides a bubble indicator for detecting bubbles and measuring their duration. We implement our strategy to investigate the phenomenon called the “green bubble” in the field of renewable energy investment.
title: Bubble detection with application to green bubbles: A noncausal approach
title_zh: 泡沫检测及其在绿色泡沫中的应用：一种非因果方法

abstract: Health inequalities often originate in early childhood, but millions of children miss the critical intervention window of the first 1000 days of life. We investigate whether nutritional investments during the school years can help these children recover. To do so, we analyze China’s Nutrition Improvement Program (NIP), the world’s third-largest school feeding program. Using nationally representative longitudinal data from 2010 to 2018 and difference-in-differences models, we find substantial and cumulative gains in height-for-age and reductions in stunting. The program also lowers overweight and obesity, suggesting that school feeding can alleviate undernutrition without exacerbating overnutrition. Moreover, children with poorer nutritional status and lower socioeconomic status experience greater improvements from the NIP; among them, those with better access to healthcare services in early life are more likely to recover from stunting. Shifts in dietary patterns and reduced morbidity likely drive the program’s effects. Our findings indicate that interventions targeting school-age children can generate meaningful growth recovery and reduce health disparities that emerge early in life.

abstract: This paper studies the efficacy of Price Level Targeting (PLT) under the Heuristic Switching Model (HSM). PLT has been considered as an alternative to the traditional inflation targeting in the aftermath of the 2008 Great Recession. However, this policy was not thoroughly tested in real life, whereas the experimental evidence remains contradictory. This study contributes to the discussion by extending the HSM by Hommes and Lustenhouwer (2019) with the PLT Taylor rule. The properties of the PLT rule under the behavioral expectations are mixed. On the one hand, the fundamental steady state becomes the unique fixed point of the system in this setup. However, the stability of this fixed point is highly sensitive to the calibration of the underlying New Keynesian economy, and the exact specification of the HSM. As a result, policy makers can use this policy only if they understand well the way in which the economic agents form their expectations.
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: Macroeconomic stability of price level targeting in a model of heterogeneous expectations
title_zh: 异质性预期模型下价格水平目标制的宏观经济稳定性

abstract: The International Federation of Surveyors (FIG) has globally influenced land administration through its Cadastre 2014 vision and subsequent LADM standards. Türkiye has been modernizing its land registry and cadastre system accordingly. The General Directorate of Land Registry and Cadastre (GDLRC) manages approximately 17 million annual transactions, including about 3.4 million conveyancing (long-term averages). To reduce congestion in Land Registry Offices (LROs), notaries were authorized to issue sales contracts in June 2022. This study investigates the effects of this change within the Cadastre 2014/2034 framework in terms of the maturity of the Turkish Land Administration System (LAS) and also by linking the issue to broader debates within land management and governance. A survey of 140 GDLRC experts revealed that notary involvement currently offers limited time and financial benefits to citizens and does not significantly reduce LRO workload. The central factor for this limitation is evaluated to be the maturity of Turkish LAS. On the other hand, the initiative aligns with Cadastre 2014’s fifth statement, which advocates public-private collaboration, and therefore it should be further evolved. Within this evolution, administrative/managerial fixes and training programmes for notaries in the short term, management of all internal and external RRRs via LAS as a spatial data infrastructure service in line with LADM standards in the medium term, and betterment of institutional coordination, public responsibility development and capacity building in the long term are proposed for a better eventual land administration and management towards local and national good land governance.
title: Authorisation of notary publics on real property transactions in relation to the Turkish land registry system based on “Cadastre 2014 vision”
title_zh: 基于“2014年地籍愿景”的土耳其土地登记制度中公证人对不动产交易的授权

abstract: Individuals may care about status both because of how they view their own position and because of how others perceive it. We compare these two dimensions using five hypothetical discrete-choice experiments that separately vary absolute outcomes, self-perceived standing, and socially-perceived standing in the domains of income, academic performance, and car safety. The analysis sample includes 4934 U.S. respondents and two elicitation tasks: a non-incentivized own-choice task and an incentivized coordination game in which respondents are rewarded for predicting the modal choice. Across four of the five experimental conditions, socially-perceived standing enters positively, while self-perceived standing is either negative or statistically indistinguishable from zero. The exception is the income own-choice condition, where the pattern reverses—a result that warrants further research.
title: Feeling rich or looking rich? Self-perceived vs socially-perceived relative income
title_zh: 感觉富有还是看起来富有？自我感知与社会感知的相对收入

abstract: Intergroup contact interventions often yield limited results in deeply divided societies. We test contact and empathy education in Lebanon, where Syrian refugees comprise a quarter of the population. In a fully cross-randomised field experiment with 887 Lebanese and Syrian youth embedded in a psychosocial support programme, we find that contact has little effect on outgroup attitudes and behaviour, while empathy education consistently improves attitudes for Lebanese youth and behavioural engagement for both. The combined treatment achieves little beyond empathy alone, with no evidence of spillovers to parents (n = 595). In polarised settings, empathy education should precede — or replace — contact.
abstract_zh: 在深度分裂的社会中，群体间接触干预往往收效有限。我们在黎巴嫩测试了接触与共情教育，叙利亚难民占该国人口的四分之一。在一项完全交叉随机的实地实验中，887名黎巴嫩和叙利亚青年被纳入一项社会心理支持项目。我们发现，接触对外群体态度和行为几乎没有影响，而共情教育持续改善了黎巴嫩青年的态度以及两者的行为参与。联合干预相较单独共情教育收效甚微，且没有证据表明对父母（n = 595）存在溢出效应。在极化环境中，共情教育应优先于接触——或取代接触。
title: Intergroup Contact, Empathy Education, and Refugee-Native Integration in Lebanon
title_zh: 群体间接触、共情教育与黎巴嫩难民—本地居民融合

abstract: This study proposes the DNS-IMF-TVL-GARCH model incorporating mixed-frequency macroeconomic data, time-varying factor loadings, and GARCH-type volatility for Treasury bond yield dynamics. The model effectively captures complex nonlinear relationships between dynamic Nelson–Siegel factors and macroeconomic variables. Furthermore, we develop a new estimation strategy integrating the unscented Kalman filter with the bootstrap method to extract latent high-frequency macro factors while accounting for time-varying residual volatility. Empirical results demonstrate superior in-sample model fit and out-of-sample forecasting accuracy across horizons. Economic evaluations confirm that the proposed model outperforms other variants, delivering the highest Sharpe ratio and certainty equivalent return in dynamic portfolio allocation. Moreover, we document a strong correlation between the money supply (M2) and the time-varying loading parameter λ . We also find that foreign exchange noise is partially absorbed by the residual structure, thereby improving the model’s capacity to capture bond yield dynamics.
abstract_zh: 本研究提出DNS-IMF-TVL-GARCH模型，将混频宏观经济数据、时变因子载荷与GARCH类波动率纳入国债收益率动态建模。该模型有效刻画了动态Nelson–Siegel因子与宏观经济变量之间复杂的非线性关系。进一步，我们构建了一种新的估计策略，将无迹卡尔曼滤波与自助法相结合，在考虑时变残差波动率的同时提取潜在高频宏观因子。实证结果表明，该模型在样本内拟合优度与不同期限的样本外预测精度方面均表现更优。经济评估证实，所提模型优于其他变体，在动态投资组合配置中实现了最高的夏普比率与确定性等价收益。此外，我们记录了货币供应量（M2）与时变载荷参数λ之间的强相关性。我们还发现，外汇噪声被残差结构部分吸收，从而提升了模型刻画债券收益率动态的能力。
title: A dynamic Nelson–Siegel model for treasury bond yields with irregular mixed-frequency macroeconomic information
title_zh: 基于不规则混频宏观经济信息的国债收益率动态Nelson-Siegel模型

abstract: This paper explores the relationships between overall diet quality and attitudes toward risk and time using a general population survey. We combine a food frequency questionnaire and a choice-based preference module to elicit individual risk and time preferences. The online questionnaire was administered to a socioeconomic panel representative of the French population. We show that risk and time preferences are associated with individual heterogeneity in key aspects of diet quality, a result that holds across a wide range of robustness checks. Using a hierarchical Bayes framework, we jointly estimate individual risk aversion and impatience parameters and show that associations hold for both model-free and structural estimates of risk and time preferences. We further show that these associations account for a substantial share of the heterogeneity in dietary outcomes beyond sociodemographic controls. Risk and time preferences contribute to both the income–diet-quality and education–diet-quality gradients, but in opposite directions, resulting in a limited net contribution to explaining socioeconomic inequalities in diet quality.
abstract_zh: 本文利用一项一般人群调查，探讨了整体饮食质量与风险和时间态度之间的关系。我们结合食物频率问卷和基于选择的偏好模块，以引出个体的风险偏好和时间偏好。该在线问卷面向一个具有法国人口代表性的社会经济小组发放。我们发现，风险偏好和时间偏好与饮食质量关键方面的个体异质性相关，这一结果在广泛的稳健性检验中均成立。采用分层贝叶斯框架，我们联合估计了个体风险厌恶和不耐烦参数，并表明这些关联对风险偏好和时间偏好的无模型估计和结构估计均成立。我们进一步表明，这些关联在超越社会人口控制变量之外，解释了饮食结果异质性的相当大一部分。风险偏好和时间偏好对收入—饮食质量和教育—饮食质量梯度均有贡献，但方向相反，导致其在解释饮食质量社会经济不平等方面的净贡献有限。
title: Risk, time, and diet quality: Evidence from a general population survey
title_zh: 风险、时间与饮食质量：来自一般人群调查的证据

abstract: We study demand for symmetric and asymmetric information sources in the laboratory. Although participants respond to incentives and instrumental considerations, they exhibit a systematic bias towards symmetric sources. These patterns persist among individuals with higher cognitive abilities and better task comprehension, and they are not accounted for by their elicited subjective beliefs. This paper was accepted by Dorothea Kübler, behavioural economics and decision analysis. Funding: This project was supported by a British Academy/Leverhulme Small Research [Grant SG171679]. R. Z. acknowledges support from the Israel Science Foundation [Grant 524/24]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08449 .
abstract_zh: 我们在实验室中研究对对称与非对称信息源的需求。尽管参与者会对激励和工具性考量作出反应，但他们表现出对对称信息源的系统性偏好。这些模式在认知能力较高、任务理解更好的个体中依然存在，并且无法由他们所报告的主观信念来解释。本文由Dorothea Kübler（行为经济学与决策分析）接收。资助：本项目得到英国科学院/Leverhulme小额研究资助[Grant SG171679]的支持。R. Z. 感谢以色列科学基金会[Grant 524/24]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.08449获取。

title: Beyond Value: On the Role of Symmetry in Demand for Information
title_zh: 超越价值：论对称性在信息需求中的作用

abstract: Using data on electronic products across Amazon marketplaces, I study the effects of an antitrust case requiring Amazon to provide equal treatment to sellers in Buy Box, Amazon’s featured offer displayed to consumers. The remedy addresses concerns that Amazon engaged in biased Buy Box allocation and potentially distorted competition. Buy Box prices increased sharply when the decision became legally binding, with no additional increase observed at the remedy implementation deadline. Prices rose across all sellers, while Buy Box allocation shifted from Amazon toward Fulfilled by Merchant (FBM) sellers, third-party sellers responsible for their own fulfillment, whose prices increased the most.
abstract_zh: 利用亚马逊各市场中电子产品的数据，我研究了一起反垄断案件的影响，该案件要求亚马逊在Buy Box（亚马逊向消费者展示的推荐报价）中给予卖家平等待遇。该救济措施回应了有关亚马逊在Buy Box分配中存在偏向并可能扭曲竞争的担忧。当该裁决具有法律约束力时，Buy Box价格大幅上涨，而在救济措施实施截止日期时未观察到进一步上涨。所有卖家的价格均上涨，同时Buy Box分配从亚马逊转向由卖家自行配送（FBM）卖家，即负责自行履约的第三方卖家，其价格上涨幅度最大。
title: Does equal treatment help consumers? Evidence from Amazon’s Buy Box remedy
title_zh: 平等对待是否有利于消费者？来自亚马逊“购买框”补救措施的证据

abstract: Against China’s growth slowdown, we study how China’s staggered “de-emphasizing GDP” cadre evaluation reforms that reduce emphasis on relative GDP growth performance reweight local policy responses across multiple evaluation objectives. Using prefecture-level adoption (2013–2023) and city commercial bank loan-level data, we find reforms shift local credit toward high-tech firms and away from real estate and elevated housing downside risk, with larger effects where promotion incentives are stronger. The response is concentrated in local CCB lending to local firms, and a scale–composition decomposition attributes the sectoral effects almost entirely to within-portfolio reallocation. A Holmström–Milgrom multitask framework rationalizes this reallocation.
abstract_zh: 在中国经济增长放缓的背景下，我们研究了中国错峰实施的“淡化GDP”干部考核改革如何降低对相对GDP增长绩效的重视，从而重新调整地方对多重考核目标的政策响应。利用地级市层面的改革采纳数据（2013—2023年）以及城市商业银行贷款层面数据，我们发现改革将地方信贷转向高科技企业，并使其从房地产和较高的住房下行风险中撤出，且在晋升激励更强的地方效应更大。这一响应集中体现为地方城市商业银行向本地企业发放贷款，而规模—构成分解表明，部门效应几乎完全归因于组合内部再配置。一个Holmström–Milgrom多任务框架为这种再配置提供了合理解释。

title: Beyond GDP tournaments: Cadre evaluation reform and sectoral credit allocation
title_zh: 超越GDP锦标赛：干部考核改革与部门信贷配置

abstract: We study the strategic choice of spatial price policy (uniform pricing versus spatial price discrimination) in a linear city with quadratic transport costs and endogenous locations, under two alternative three-stage game orderings (following Eber, 1997). The asymmetric subgame (in which one firm discriminates while the other prices uniformly) is solved via the mixed-strategy Nash equilibrium under simultaneous price competition, replacing the Stackelberg standard of Thisse and Vives (1988). In Game I (location/pricing policy/prices), the policy game is a coordination game: both are Nash equilibria but mutual uniform pricing Pareto dominates mutual discrimination. This overturns the Prisoner’s Dilemma that arises under the Stackelberg standard, in which price discrimination is a dominant strategy. In Game II (pricing policy/location/prices), mutual uniform pricing is the unique equilibrium.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在具有二次运输成本和内生位置的线性城市中，空间价格政策（统一定价与空间价格歧视）的战略选择，并考察两种替代性的三阶段博弈顺序（遵循Eber，1997）。非对称子博弈（其中一家企业实行歧视，另一家实行统一定价）在同时价格竞争下通过混合策略纳什均衡求解，取代了Thisse和Vives（1988）的Stackelberg标准。在博弈I（位置/定价政策/价格）中，政策博弈是一个协调博弈：两者均为纳什均衡，但相互统一定价帕累托优于相互歧视。这颠覆了在Stackelberg标准下出现的囚徒困境，在该困境中价格歧视是占优策略。在博弈II（定价政策/位置/价格）中，相互统一定价是唯一均衡。
title: Endogenous Location and Pricing Policy: Mixed Strategies Make Uniform Pricing Commitment Successful
title_zh: 内生选址与定价政策：混合策略使统一定价承诺成功

abstract: Conventional market-based measures of real interest rates violate the Fisher equation. Because of lagged inflation indexation, nominal and inflation components cover different horizons, creating a timing distortion that can bias real-time assessments of the monetary policy stance. We propose a Fisher-consistent measure of the short-term real rate using inflation fixing swaps, whose monthly maturities allow precise alignment across horizons. In euro-area data, our measure diverges substantially from the conventional one around sharp inflation repricing, by up to 3 percentage points. Ahead of several ECB meetings, it even points to opposite dynamics: real-rate tightening instead of easing, and vice versa.
abstract_zh: 传统的基于市场的实际利率度量违反了费雪方程。由于通胀滞后指数化，名义成分与通胀成分覆盖的期限不同，造成时点扭曲，可能使对货币政策立场的实时评估产生偏误。我们提出一种费雪一致性的短期实际利率度量，使用通胀定息互换，其月度到期结构使各期限能够精确对齐。在欧元区数据中，我们的度量在通胀剧烈重定价前后与传统度量出现显著背离，幅度最高达3个百分点。在数次欧洲央行会议之前，它甚至指向相反的动态：实际利率收紧而非放松，反之亦然。
title: A Fisher-consistent measure of real interest rates from inflation fixing swaps
title_zh: 基于通胀互换的实际利率的费雪一致测度

abstract: A familiar U-shape links early-stage entrepreneurship to income per capita and is often read as a development path. I test that reading by asking whether the curve turns inside observed support, where it is located, and whether it survives within countries. The pooled quadratic opens upward but does not turn inside observed support. The in-support U-shape appears only among high-income economies. Within that group, country fixed effects detect no significant curvature, and the Mundlak point estimates show positive between-country but near-zero within-country curvature. The evidence is stronger for a cross-sectional pattern among rich economies than for a common within-country path.
abstract_zh: 一个常见的U形关系将早期创业与人均收入联系起来，并常被解读为一条发展路径。我通过追问该曲线是否在观测支撑范围内发生转向、其位置何在，以及它是否在国家内部依然成立，来检验这一解读。混合二次曲线开口向上，但并未在观测支撑范围内发生转向。支撑范围内的U形仅出现在高收入经济体中。在该组内，国家固定效应未检测到显著曲率，而Mundlak点估计显示国家间曲率为正，但国家内曲率接近于零。相较于一条共同的国家内路径，证据更有力地支持富裕经济体之间存在一种横截面模式。
title: The entrepreneurship U-shape: Pattern or path?
title_zh: 创业的U型：模式还是路径？

abstract: Organ transplantation saves lives and improves the quality of life of patients who would otherwise depend on costly and invasive treatments. The technology is becoming available in low- and middle-income countries, but the gap between the demand for and the supply of organ transplants remains large. In a randomized controlled trial at a Tunisian university, we evaluate an expert-led intervention designed to inform about organ donation and strengthen trust in medical institutions. The intervention consists of a short video testimonial from a heart transplant survivor, a presentation led by a medical doctor and a short Q&A session. We find that the intervention significantly increases deceased donor registration, with suggestive evidence of positive spillover effects on the control group. The survey data provides little support for changes in attitudes and social expectations as potential mechanisms. Instead, it reveals large and statistically significant increases in medical and legal knowledge, religious beliefs supportive of donation, and institutional trust among treated students. Finally, we show that treatment effects on organ donor registration are driven by male students and those whose families likely support organ donation. Targeting older segments of the population may further increase the impact and cost-effectiveness of this intervention.
abstract_zh: 器官移植能够挽救生命，并改善那些原本依赖昂贵且有创治疗的患者的生活质量。这项技术在低收入和中等收入国家正逐渐普及，但器官移植的需求与供给之间仍存在巨大缺口。在突尼斯一所大学开展的一项随机对照试验中，我们评估了一项由专家主导的干预措施，旨在提供器官捐献相关信息并增强对医疗机构的信任。该干预包括一段心脏移植幸存者的短视频证言、一场由医生主讲的报告以及简短的问答环节。我们发现，该干预显著提高了 deceased donor registration（ deceased donor registration），并有提示性证据表明对对照组存在正向溢出效应。调查数据几乎不支持态度和社会期望变化作为潜在机制。相反，它显示接受干预的学生在医学和法律知识、支持捐献的宗教信仰以及机构信任方面出现了大幅且统计上显著的增长。最后，我们表明，对器官捐献者登记的处理效应主要由男学生以及那些家庭可能支持器官捐献的学生驱动。针对年龄较大的人群可能会进一步扩大该干预的影响和成本效益。
title: Fostering institutional trust and organ donation: Evidence from a randomized informational intervention in Tunisia
title_zh: 促进制度信任与器官捐献：来自突尼斯随机信息干预的证据

abstract: We provide micro-founded evidence on how establishment-level adoption of frontier technologies shapes the economy-wide occupational employment structure. Linking survey data on technology adoption between 2011 and 2016 by 1660 German incumbent establishments to administrative worker records, we find that establishments adopting frontier technologies such as AI or smart factories contributed disproportionately to the overall decline in routine jobs. Crucially, these overall effects do not stem from average within-establishment adjustments but from a subset of large and less routine-intensive adopters. Our findings highlight that frontier technology adoption is not routine-replacing per se: establishment size and an initially non-routine-intensive workforce are key conditions for de-routinization to occur.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于企业层面采用前沿技术如何塑造整个经济职业就业结构的微观基础证据。将2011年至2016年间1660家德国存量企业技术采用的调查数据与行政工人记录相链接，我们发现，采用人工智能或智能工厂等前沿技术的企业对常规性工作的总体下降作出了不成比例的贡献。至关重要的是，这些总体效应并非源于企业内部的平均调整，而是源于一部分规模较大且常规密集度较低的采用者。我们的发现强调，前沿技术采用本身并非替代常规性工作：企业规模和初始非常规密集型劳动力是去常规化得以发生的关键条件。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 250
title: Frontier technology adopters and the aggregate decline of routine jobs
title_zh: 前沿技术采用者与常规工作的总体减少

abstract: We study a multi-agent contract design problem with moral hazard. In our model, each agent exerts costly effort towards an individual task at which it may either succeed or fail, and the principal, who wishes to encourage effort, has an exclusive-use budget that it can use to reward the agents. A motivating application is crowdsourcing for innovation, where a fixed budget is provided to a crowdsourcing platform to use for rewarding participants based on their submissions. Our main contribution is to introduce a novel class of contracts, which we call Luce contracts, and show that there is always a Luce contract that is optimal. A Luce contract assigns weights and a priority order to the agents, and distributes the entire budget among the highest-priority successful agents in proportion to their weights. Furthermore, we characterize effort profiles that can be implemented by Luce contracts and show that Luce contracts offer a way to mitigate the uncertainty in total payments compared to alternative contracts—such as piece-rate or bonus-pool contracts—suggesting their desirability even in environments without budget constraints.
abstract_zh: 我们研究一个具有道德风险的多智能体合同设计问题。在我们的模型中，每个智能体针对一项个体任务付出有成本的努力，该任务可能成功也可能失败，而委托人希望激励努力，并拥有一个可专门用于奖励智能体的排他性使用预算。一个具有启发性的应用是面向创新的众包，其中向众包平台提供固定预算，用于根据参与者的提交对其进行奖励。我们的主要贡献是引入一类新颖的合同，我们称之为Luce合同，并证明始终存在一个最优的Luce合同。Luce合同为智能体分配权重和优先级顺序，并将全部预算按权重比例分配给优先级最高的成功智能体。此外，我们刻画了可由Luce合同实施的努力配置，并表明与替代合同——如计件合同或奖金池合同——相比，Luce合同提供了一种缓解总支付不确定性的方式，这表明即使在没有预算约束的环境中，它们也是可取的。
title: Multi-Agent Contract Design with a Budget
title_zh: 预算约束下的多智能体合约设计

abstract: This paper provides a unified framework to understand the effect of oil price changes on the dynamics of consumption, income and wealth inequality. Using data on macroeconomic aggregates, oil prices, and inequality metrics, we first employ a structural vector autoregressive model to show that an increase in oil prices leads to a persistent rise in income and wealth inequality. To understand these dynamics, we then solve an incomplete market model with aggregate oil price shocks, and calibrate the model to the US data. We find that when oil serves as both a consumption good and a production input, positive oil price shocks increase inequality. While the initial rise in inequality is driven by oil-induced stagflation, which forces poorer households to deplete more of their wealth to cover basic consumption, the quicker rebound in interest rates compared to the slower recovery in wages explains why inequality remains persistently elevated.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了一个统一框架，以理解油价变动对消费、收入和财富不平等动态的影响。利用宏观经济总量、油价和不平等指标的数据，我们首先采用结构向量自回归模型表明，油价上涨会导致收入和财富不平等持续上升。为理解这些动态，我们随后求解了一个包含总体油价冲击的不完全市场模型，并根据美国数据对模型进行了校准。我们发现，当石油同时作为消费品和生产投入品时，正向油价冲击会加剧不平等。虽然不平等的初始上升由油价引发的滞胀驱动——这迫使较贫困家庭消耗更多财富以支付基本消费，但利率相对于工资的更快反弹解释了为何不平等持续处于高位。
title: Oil prices and inequality
title_zh: 油价与不平等

abstract: Geopolitical shocks are not all alike—different classes of geopolitical shocks can have different macroeconomic implications, particularly for inflation. This paper exploits the comovement between the Geopolitical Risk Index (GPR) and oil prices across major geopolitical events to disentangle two types of geopolitical shocks within a structural VAR model for the US economy. The VAR estimates show that geopolitical shocks associated with disruptions in energy markets are on average inflationary and contractionary. In contrast, geopolitical shocks associated with macroeconomic developments that are unrelated to energy markets are on average deflationary and contractionary. The paper validates this interpretation using cross-country and sectoral variation in output and prices. Sectors with higher energy intensity experience larger price increases following geopolitical energy shocks, while no comparable pattern emerges following geopolitical macro shocks. These results suggest that the inflationary consequences of geopolitical risk depend critically on the underlying nature of the shock.
abstract_zh: 地缘政治冲击并非千篇一律——不同类型的地缘政治冲击可能具有不同的宏观经济影响，尤其是在通胀方面。本文利用地缘政治风险指数（GPR）与油价在重大地缘政治事件中的共同变动，在美国经济的结构向量自回归（VAR）模型中区分出两类地缘政治冲击。VAR估计表明，与能源市场中断相关的地缘政治冲击平均而言具有通胀效应和收缩效应。相比之下，与能源市场无关的宏观经济发展相关的地缘政治冲击平均而言具有通缩效应和收缩效应。本文利用产出和价格的跨国差异与部门差异验证了这一解释。能源强度较高的部门在地缘政治能源冲击后经历更大幅度的价格上涨，而在地缘政治宏观冲击后则未出现类似模式。这些结果表明，地缘政治风险的通胀后果关键取决于冲击的内在性质。
title: Geopolitical risk and inflation: The role of energy markets
title_zh: 地缘政治风险与通货膨胀：能源市场的作用

abstract: This paper develops a test for evaluating linear factor models in high-dimensional settings. The proposed Maximum Random Sparse Portfolio (MRSP) test generates L random sparse portfolios, each obtained through K random draws, and then selects the hardest-to-price portfolio to assess factor model performance. By evaluating multiple randomly generated sparse portfolios, the MRSP test retains a portfolio-based economic interpretation while avoiding reliance on a single hardest-to-price asset. Under the null hypothesis and the stated regularity conditions, the centered MRSP statistic converges to a type I extreme value distribution. Monte Carlo simulations show stable finite-sample performance. In the empirical application, model fit generally improves in recent years, although the evidence varies across factor models and test assets. The 3-factor model of Daniel, Hirshleifer, and Sun (2020, Review of Financial Studies ) performs best among the models considered. abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在高维情形下评估线性因子模型的检验方法。所提出的最大随机稀疏投资组合（MRSP）检验生成L个随机稀疏投资组合，每个投资组合通过K次随机抽取得到，然后选择最难定价的投资组合来评估因子模型表现。通过评估多个随机生成的稀疏投资组合，MRSP检验保留了基于投资组合的经济学解释，同时避免依赖单一最难定价资产。在原假设和所述正则条件下，中心化MRSP统计量收敛于I型极值分布。蒙特卡洛模拟显示其有限样本表现稳定。在实证应用中，模型拟合近年来总体有所改善，尽管证据因因子模型和检验资产而异。Daniel、Hirshleifer和Sun（2020，Review of Financial Studies）的三因子模型在所考虑的模型中表现最佳。关键词：资产定价检验 高维资产 模型比较 随机稀疏投资组合 极大型检验 免责声明：作为向作者和研究人员提供的一项服务，我们提供的是已接受稿件（AM）的这一版本。在最终出版记录版本（VoR）之前，将对该稿件进行文字编辑、排版以及生成校样。在生产制作和印前阶段，可能会发现影响内容的错误，所有与该期刊相关的法律免责声明也适用于这些版本。请注意：选择许可并不提供对文章全文的访问权限，请参阅我们的帮助页面“如何查看内容？” 学术许可：通过Rightslink点击下方按钮可立即获得许可：申请学术许可。更多信息，请访问我们的许可帮助页面。企业许可：如需申请本文的企业许可，请点击下方按钮：申请企业许可。转载：如需申请本文转载，请点击下方按钮：订购转载。分享 返回顶部

abstract: We meta-analyze field studies published over the past 15 years to examine whether information nudges promote environmentally sustainable food choices in real-world settings, which types of information nudges elicit stronger behavioral responses, and under what conditions their effects vary. Drawing on 143 effect sizes from 63 field studies across 45 articles, we find that, on average, information nudges yield a modest but significant effect in promoting pro-environmental food choices. We classify information nudges into five common types: descriptive sustainability labeling, evaluative sustainability labeling, social norms, hedonic appeals, and calls for sustainable food choices. There is no clear evidence that any of the five types produces larger effects than the others. Instead, the results indicate that the effects of information nudges vary by study design, intervention duration, year of implementation, setting, and outcome measure. Specifically, nudge effects appear larger in studies using pre–post designs with a control group than in those without a control group, in studies with shorter intervention durations, in studies implemented before 2020 than in those implemented between 2020 and 2025, and in studies conducted in off-site eateries than in on-site cafeterias. Information nudges also tend to be more effective in reducing unsustainable food choices than in increasing sustainable ones. Nevertheless, the effect estimates remain modest across all examined moderator categories.
abstract_zh: 我们对过去15年发表的实地研究进行元分析，以考察信息助推是否在真实环境中促进环境可持续食品选择、哪些类型的信息助推引发更强的行为反应，以及其效应在何种条件下存在差异。基于来自45篇文章中63项实地研究的143个效应量，我们发现，平均而言，信息助推在促进亲环境食品选择方面产生了适度但显著的效应。我们将信息助推分为五种常见类型：描述性可持续性标签、评价性可持续性标签、社会规范、享乐诉求以及呼吁选择可持续食品。没有明确证据表明这五种类型中的任何一种比其他类型产生更大的效应。相反，结果表明，信息助推的效应因研究设计、干预持续时间、实施年份、场景和结果测量而异。具体而言，在使用带对照组的前后测设计的研究中，助推效应似乎大于无对照组的研究；在干预持续时间较短的研究中更大；在2020年之前实施的研究中大于2020年至2025年间实施的研究；在非现场餐饮场所开展的研究中大于现场食堂中的研究。信息助推在减少不可持续食品选择方面也往往比在增加可持续食品选择方面更有效。尽管如此，在所有考察的调节变量类别中，效应估计仍然适度。
title: Information nudges for environmentally sustainable food choices: A meta-analysis of field studies
title_zh: 信息助推促进环境可持续食品选择：实地研究的元分析

abstract: Drawing on prefecture-level panel data from 2007 to 2023 and government-guided fund data from the Zero2IPO Private Equity Database, this study employs a staggered difference-in-differences (DID) model to examine the impact of government-guided funds on regional employment, along with the underlying mechanisms and boundary conditions. The findings reveal that: (1) government-guided funds significantly enhance regional employment scale; (2) the employment effect operates through four channels: amplifying venture capital, increasing financial loans, augmenting fiscal expenditure on employment, and stimulating entrepreneurship; (3) the effect is stronger in peripheral cities, non-eastern regions, and the secondary sector, with venture capital funds outperforming industrial investment funds, while PPP funds show no significant effect; and (4) local fiscal expenditures on science and technology, education, and environmental protection reinforce this employment impact, highlighting the value of policy synergy. abstract_zh: 本研究基于2007年至2023年的地级市面板数据以及清科私募通数据库中的政府引导基金数据，采用交错双重差分（DID）模型，考察政府引导基金对区域就业的影响及其作用机制和边界条件。研究发现：（1）政府引导基金显著提升了区域就业规模；（2）其就业效应通过四条渠道发挥作用：放大风险投资、增加金融贷款、扩大就业财政支出以及激发创业；（3）该效应在外围城市、非东部地区和第二产业中更强，其中风险投资基金的表现优于产业投资基金，而PPP基金则未表现出显著效应；（4）地方在科技、教育和环境保护方面的财政支出强化了这一就业影响，凸显了政策协同的价值。关键词：政府引导基金 就业 财政分权 因果中介分析 政策协同 JEL分类：G00 O10

abstract: Digital industry agglomeration significantly influences urban low-carbon development, with environmental effects that differ across agglomeration stages. This study analyzes panel data from 280 Chinese prefecture-level cities spanning 2009 to 2023 to assess the impact of digital industry agglomeration on urban carbon emission intensity. The empirical approach integrates nonlinear panel regressions, a nonlinear mediation model, and a spatial Durbin model to identify nonlinear, mediating, and spatial effects. The findings reveal a pronounced inverted U-shaped relationship between digital industry agglomeration and urban carbon emission intensity. Additionally, digital industry agglomeration exhibits a U-shaped effect on green technological innovation, indicating that the innovation effect initially weakens and subsequently strengthens as agglomeration deepens, thereby generating stage-dependent indirect effects on carbon emission intensity through the green patent channel. Spatial marginal effects also display nonlinear variation with the degree of digital industry agglomeration. At lower agglomeration levels, the total spatial marginal effect is positive, indicating increased carbon emission intensity across the regional system. As agglomeration intensifies, the total effect diminishes and ultimately becomes significantly negative, indicating a transition towards cross-regional emissions reduction. These results offer policy-relevant insights for designing low-carbon strategies tailored to different stages of digital industry agglomeration and for enhancing cross-regional coordination. KEYWORDS: Digital industry agglomeration carbon emission intensity inverted U-shaped relationship spatial marginal effects JEL CLASSIFICATION: O33 Q56 R11 R12
abstract_zh: 数字产业集聚对城市低碳发展具有显著影响，且其环境效应在不同集聚阶段存在差异。本研究基于2009年至2023年中国280个地级市的面板数据，评估数字产业集聚对城市碳排放强度的影响。实证方法整合了非线性面板回归、非线性中介模型和空间杜宾模型，以识别非线性效应、中介效应和空间效应。研究发现，数字产业集聚与城市碳排放强度之间呈现明显的倒U型关系。此外，数字产业集聚对绿色技术创新具有U型影响，表明随着集聚程度加深，创新效应先减弱后增强，从而通过绿色专利渠道对碳排放强度产生阶段依赖性的间接效应。空间边际效应也随数字产业集聚程度呈现非线性变化。在较低集聚水平下，总空间边际效应为正，表明区域系统内碳排放强度上升。随着集聚加剧，总效应减弱并最终变为显著负值，表明向跨区域减排转变。这些结果为针对数字产业集聚不同阶段设计低碳战略以及加强跨区域协调提供了政策相关启示。关键词：数字产业集聚；碳排放强度；倒U型关系；空间边际效应。JEL分类：O33 Q56 R11 R12

title: Mechanisms and spatial effects of digital industry agglomeration on urban carbon emission intensity

abstract: We study the effects of North Carolina’s Advanced Placement (AP) exam fee-waiver policy on exam participation and potential college-credit attainment conditional on AP enrollment. Using student-course level administrative data, we first exploit within-student variation among students enrolled in multiple AP courses during both pre- and post-waiver periods. We find that fee waivers increased exam participation by 2.1 percentage points but did not significantly increase the share of AP enrollments yielding an exam score of 3 or higher, a common threshold for college-credit eligibility. This average null, however, masks a 3-percentage-point increase in the share of low-SES AP enrollments yielding a score of 3 or higher, narrowing the baseline attainment gap by 15 percent. Using the full sample of AP enrollments and a difference-in-differences framework, we then show that enrollments with the lowest predicted exam-taking propensity absent the waiver experienced the largest gains in both exam participation and potential college-credit attainment, suggesting that universal fee waivers generate larger benefits where barriers to AP exam participation are most likely to bind. Under illustrative assumptions, our welfare calculations indicate that the policy’s benefits far exceed its costs.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了北卡罗来纳州大学先修课程（AP）考试费用减免政策对考试参与率的影响，以及在AP选课条件下对潜在大学学分获取的影响。利用学生—课程层面的行政数据，我们首先在学生内部进行差异分析，样本为在费用减免政策实施前后均选修多门AP课程的学生。我们发现，费用减免使考试参与率提高了2.1个百分点，但并未显著提高AP选课中获得3分及以上成绩的比例——3分通常是获得大学学分资格的常见门槛。然而，这一平均意义上的零效应掩盖了低收入社会经济地位（SES）学生AP选课中获得3分及以上成绩比例提高3个百分点的事实，使基线成绩差距缩小了15%。随后，我们使用全部AP选课样本和双重差分框架表明，在若无费用减免政策时预测考试参与倾向最低的选课，在考试参与率和潜在大学学分获取方面的提升幅度最大，这表明普遍性费用减免在AP考试参与障碍最可能起约束作用的地方产生了更大的收益。在示例性假设下，我们的福利计算表明，该政策的收益远超其成本。
title: Removing barriers to college credits: Where and for whom AP exam fee waivers work
title_zh: 消除大学学分障碍：AP考试费用减免在何处及对谁有效

abstract: Land take is primarily driven by urbanisation and infrastructure development and is closely linked to soil sealing, which involves covering soil with impervious materials. Over recent decades, both processes have steadily increased in European urban areas, significantly impacting ecosystem services. To stop these processes, the European Commission has set two distinct targets: "no net land take" and ”no net soil sealing”. To examine the relationship between the two processes, we introduce the Sealed-to-Artificial area Ratio (SAR), a novel indicator defined as the ratio between sealed areas and artificial areas in a certain region. We computed SAR for 661 Functional Urban Areas (FUAs) in the 27 countries of the European Union plus the UK, and its change between 2012 and 2018. Two hypotheses were tested: (1) SAR tends to decrease in FUAs with predominant agricultural land cover, as opposed to artificial; and (2) SAR tends to increase as urban form becomes more compact, as opposed to sprawling. Results show a general decrease in SAR (median of –0.36), indicating a possible trend toward lower-intensity urban development. However, regional variations emerge, with the UK-Ireland showing a greater decrease and the Southern region a smaller reduction. As expected, SAR increased in FUAs with a high share of artificial land cover and a tendency towards a more compact urban form, while those with larger availability of agricultural land and a sprawling development showed the opposite trend. The proposed indicators can be used to support urban planning and local policies to achieve European targets.
abstract_zh: 土地占用主要由城市化和基础设施建设驱动，并与土壤封闭密切相关，后者涉及用不透水材料覆盖土壤。近几十年来，这两种过程在欧洲城市地区持续加剧，对生态系统服务产生了显著影响。为遏制这些过程，欧盟委员会设定了两个不同的目标：“无净土地占用”和“无净土壤封闭”。为考察这两个过程之间的关系，我们引入了封闭—人工面积比（SAR），这是一个新指标，定义为某一区域内封闭面积与人工面积之比。我们计算了欧盟27国加英国共661个功能城市区（FUA）的SAR，以及其在2012年至2018年间的变化。我们检验了两个假设：（1）在以农业土地覆盖为主的FUA中，SAR倾向于下降，而在以人工土地覆盖为主的FUA中则相反；（2）随着城市形态变得更加紧凑而非蔓延，SAR倾向于上升。结果显示，SAR总体下降（中位数为–0.36），表明可能存在向较低强度城市开发发展的趋势。然而，区域差异也随之显现，英国—爱尔兰地区降幅更大，南部地区降幅较小。正如预期，在人工土地覆盖比例高且趋向更紧凑城市形态的FUA中，SAR上升；而在农业用地可获得性较大且呈现蔓延式发展的FUA中，则表现出相反趋势。所提出的指标可用于支持城市规划和地方政策，以实现欧洲目标。
title: Temporal and spatial patterns of the Sealed-to-Artificial area Ratio in European urban areas
title_zh: 欧洲城市地区封闭地表与人工地表比率的时间与空间格局

abstract: This paper develops a structural framework for analyzing top income taxation and applies it to six decades of U.S. tax history and to eight other advanced economies. The paper derives explicit expressions for top-bracket tax revenue and total excess burden across the full range of tax rates, while preserving local consistency with the sufficient-statistics approach of Saez (2001). Applied to the United States, the analysis implies that the current excess burden of the top federal tax bracket is $101 billion and that raising the top marginal tax rate to its revenue-maximizing level of 72 percent would increase annual revenue by $111 billion, given a taxable income elasticity of 0.25. The current tax rate is lower than what is consistent with a purely utility-based notion of social welfare. By contrast, Nordic countries and the United States in earlier decades appear to have operated at tax rates exceeding revenue-maximizing levels.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个分析顶层收入税收的结构性框架，并将其应用于美国六十年税收历史以及其他八个发达经济体。本文推导了在全部税率范围内顶层税级税收收入和总超额负担的显式表达式，同时保持与Saez（2001）充分统计量方法的局部一致性。应用于美国时，该分析表明，当前联邦顶层税级的超额负担为1010亿美元，并且在应税收入弹性为0.25的情况下，将顶层边际税率提高至其收入最大化水平72%将使年收入增加1110亿美元。当前税率低于与纯粹基于效用的社会福利概念相一致的水平。相比之下，北欧国家以及早几十年的美国似乎曾在超过收入最大化水平的税率下运行。
title: Top income taxation: Efficiency, social welfare and the Laffer curve
title_zh: 最高收入征税：效率、社会福利与拉弗曲线

abstract: We develop an agent-based model to study the economic and public health impact of global vaccine inequality. Our model contains two world regions (higher-income vs. lower-income) and captures the co-evolution between economic activity, the spread and evolution of a hypothetical novel pandemic virus, and public health responses. We calibrate and estimate the model parameters empirically with data from the COVID-19 pandemic to capture the economic and social response to pandemic viruses in both regions. Our simulations suggest that vaccine inequality can drastically exacerbate inequality in mortality in the two regions. This is because the lower-income region suffers from drastically increased mortality, while the higher-income region generally only experiences a small (if any) decrease in mortality in most simulations. However, vaccine inequality harms both regions economically. This is driven by the fact that severe vaccine inequality eliminates the prospect of eradicating a mutating virus. Any trade-off between mortality in higher- and lower-income regions can be mitigated by increasing the production of vaccine doses. Furthermore, our analysis reveals that the higher-income region benefits economically from paying for increased vaccine production.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个基于主体的模型，以研究全球疫苗不平等对经济和公共卫生的影响。我们的模型包含两个世界区域（高收入与低收入），并刻画了经济活动、一种假设的新型大流行病毒的传播与演化，以及公共卫生应对之间的共同演化。我们利用COVID-19大流行的数据，以实证方式校准并估计模型参数，以捕捉两个区域对 pandemic 病毒的经济和社会响应。我们的模拟表明，疫苗不平等可能急剧加剧两个区域在死亡率上的不平等。这是因为低收入区域的死亡率大幅上升，而高收入区域在大多数模拟中通常仅经历死亡率的小幅下降（如果有的话）。然而，疫苗不平等对两个区域的经济都有害。其驱动因素是，严重的疫苗不平等消除了根除一种不断变异的病毒的前景。高收入与低收入区域之间在死亡率上的任何权衡，都可以通过增加疫苗剂量的生产来缓解。此外，我们的分析揭示，高收入区域通过为增加疫苗生产付费而获得经济收益。

title: Global inequality in vaccine access, mortality and economy: An agent-based exploration
title_zh: 全球疫苗获取、死亡率与经济的不平等：基于主体的探索

abstract: We examine the effect of private equity buyouts on the environmental performance of U.S. fossil fuel power plants. Output-scaled CO 2 emissions are, on average, 4.2% lower after buyouts, predominantly because of fuel-saving improvements in production efficiency. Emission intensities decline more significantly following buyouts backed by pro-ESG private equity because of not only greater efficiency gains but also enhanced emission control. Our results suggest that while private equity firms are effective at implementing environmentally beneficial operational changes that also increase profitability, they do not have strong incentives to undertake environmentally beneficial changes that are privately costly, except for those with pro-ESG preferences.
abstract_zh: 本文考察私募股权收购对美国化石燃料发电厂环境绩效的影响。按产出折算的二氧化碳排放量在收购后平均降低4.2%，主要源于生产过程中燃料节约型效率改进。在具有支持ESG偏好的私募股权支持的收购之后，排放强度下降更为显著，原因不仅在于效率提升更大，还在于排放控制得到加强。我们的结果表明，私募股权公司虽能有效实施既有利于环境又能提高盈利能力的运营变革，但除具有支持ESG偏好的机构外，它们缺乏强烈激励去实施那些对自身而言成本高昂的有利于环境的变革。
journal: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
title: Private Equity and Gas Emissions: Evidence from Electric Power Plants
title_zh: 私募股权与气体排放：来自发电厂的证据

abstract: Exploiting variation in the timing of district attorney elections across nearly 40 states during the steepest rise in U.S. incarceration (roughly 1986–2006), this paper shows that election years increased per capita admissions and months sentenced to state prisons, with admissions rising 3 percent—approximately 63,000 additional prison admissions over the period. These effects were concentrated in the South, were stronger in Republican counties, and declined as public opinion softened, largely disappearing after the era ended. Results suggest that sentencing outcomes respond to voter preferences, implying that the politics underlying rising incarceration may be as important to understand as the policies themselves.
abstract_zh: 本文利用美国监禁率急剧上升期间（约1986—2006年）近40个州地区检察官选举时间上的差异，表明选举年提高了州监狱的人均入监人数和判处月数，其中入监人数上升3%——在此期间约增加63,000例监狱入监。这些效应集中在南方，在共和党县更强，并随着公众舆论缓和而减弱，在该时代结束后基本消失。结果表明，量刑结果会对选民偏好作出反应，这意味着，推动监禁率上升的政治因素可能与政策本身同样重要，值得加以理解。
title: Prosecutor politics: The impact of election cycles on criminal sentencing in the era of rising incarceration
title_zh: 检察官政治：监禁率上升时代选举周期对刑事量刑的影响

abstract: This paper studies whether standard tokenomics can account for the strong hourly return reversals observed in cryptocurrency markets. Using 319 Binance USDT pairs, we document pervasive short-horizon negative return predictability: past one-hour returns forecast subsequent one- to four-hour returns with negative coefficients for most coins, including BTC and ETH. We then show that a benchmark tokenomic model with rational expectations cannot generate this pattern because equilibrium token prices follow a geometric Brownian motion and therefore exhibit no non-overlapping return predictability. To explain the data, we introduce diagnostic expectations (DE) as the only wedge relative to the rational benchmark. Recent news shifts perceived platform productivity through a representativeness term and induces price overshooting, which is subsequently corrected as sentiment mean-reverts. The model matches the observed reversal pattern, implies that sentiment is priced in equilibrium, and generates endogenous boom-bust dynamics. We also show that the framework extends tractably to settings with heterogeneous coins and demand.
abstract_zh: 本文研究标准代币经济学能否解释加密货币市场中观察到的强烈小时收益反转现象。基于319个币安USDT交易对，我们记录了普遍存在的短期限负收益可预测性：过去一小时收益以负系数预测随后一至四小时收益，且这一现象适用于大多数币种，包括BTC和ETH。随后我们表明，一个具有理性预期的基准代币经济学模型无法生成这一模式，因为均衡代币价格遵循几何布朗运动，因此不表现出非重叠收益可预测性。为解释数据，我们引入诊断预期作为相对于理性基准的唯一楔子。近期消息通过代表性项改变感知的平台生产率，并引发价格超调，随后随着情绪均值回归而被修正。该模型与观察到的反转模式相匹配，意味着情绪在均衡中被定价，并生成内生的繁荣-萧条动态。我们还表明，该框架能够以可处理的方式扩展到具有异质币种和需求的设定。

abstract: We quantify how the magnitude of the disposition effect changes when gains and losses are defined relative to recent stock prices rather than the original purchase price. Our study uses the LDB dataset containing trading records of individual investors. Using recent prices as the reference point lowers the disposition effect. This reduction is more pronounced for active traders. Our central finding is a monotonic increase in the disposition effect with price lag length. We observe a tendency to sell stocks that recently appreciated (depreciated) with respect to stocks that recently depreciated (appreciated) in the gain (loss) domain.
abstract_zh: 我们量化了当收益和损失是相对于近期股价而非原始购买价格来定义时，处置效应的大小如何变化。我们的研究使用包含个人投资者交易记录的LDB数据集。以近期价格作为参考点会降低处置效应。这种降低在活跃交易者中更为明显。我们的核心发现是，处置效应随价格滞后长度呈单调增加。我们观察到，在收益（损失）域中，相对于近期贬值（升值）的股票，存在卖出近期升值（贬值）股票的倾向。
title: Recent stock prices as reference points and the disposition effect
title_zh: 近期股价作为参考点与处置效应

abstract: Gravity models constitute the workhorse of empirical international trade research, yet the temporal stability of their core parameters—distance and GDP elasticities—remains underexplored, particularly in relation to the evolving structure of trade networks. This study investigates the bidirectional Granger‐causal relationships between gravity model coefficients and trade network topology using two complementary databases: the OECD Inter‐Country Input–Output tables (1995–2020, 45 sectors) and the CEPII‐BACI bilateral trade database (1995–2022, 97 product groups). We employ three methodologically distinct causality testing approaches—traditional panel Granger tests, Bayesian model comparison via Bayes factors, and Random Forest‐based variable importance analysis—to establish robust directional relationships while accounting for potential nonlinearities. A key methodological innovation is the incorporation of fractal dimensions and local lacunarity distribution moments (mean, variance, skewness, kurtosis) as novel network indicators capturing multiscale heterogeneity, alongside conventional centrality and modularity measures. Using network‐based dimensionality reduction (Generalized Network‐based Dimensionality Analysis), we identify two to four distinct temporal clusters of sectors and products exhibiting heterogeneous gravity coefficient dynamics, with forecasts extended to 2030 using Bayesian ARIMA models. Our results reveal significant Granger‐causal relationships between network structural properties and gravity coefficients, but the three methods diverge sharply in how much structure they detect: the Random Forest approach identifies three‐ to four‐fold more significant sector‐and product‐level relationships than the two linear methods. At the aggregate level, centralization measures and heterogeneity indicators (lacunarity, fractal dimension) Granger‐precede GDP elasticities broadly and consistently across sectors and products, whereas their relationship with distance elasticity is concentrated in specific sectors and product groups rather than operating uniformly across the aggregate network. Distance elasticity shows declining magnitude over the study period at the aggregate level, but substantial heterogeneity persists across product groups, with some clusters exhibiting stable or even increasing distance sensitivity. The cross‐database triangulation confirms that these patterns are robust to alternative trade flow conceptualizations (gross vs. value‐added trade). These findings contribute to international trade theory in three ways. First, they provide systematic evidence of temporal precedence—established via Granger‐style tests, not structural causal identification—showing that the extensive margin of trade—captured by network topology—consistently leads the intensive margin reflected in gravity coefficients, consistent with heterogeneous firm models predicting that firms' entry/exit decisions reshape network structure before aggregate trade volumes adjust. Second, and most robustly, the documented sector‐level heterogeneity offers a structural account of the ‘distance puzzle’: ICT and services sectors exhibit genuine distance compression through network decentralization, while heavy manufacturing maintains geographic constraints through persistent regional modularity. Third, the Granger‐causal precedence of network fragility indicators over gravity coefficients establishes an empirical bridge between the production network literature on shock propagation and the gravity framework, with direct relevance for understanding supply chain resilience amid geopolitical fragmentation.
abstract_zh: 引力模型是实证国际贸易研究的主要工具，但其核心参数——距离弹性和GDP弹性——的时间稳定性仍未得到充分探讨，尤其是其与贸易网络结构演变之间的关系。本研究利用两个互补数据库：OECD国家间投入产出表（1995—2020年，45个部门）和CEPII-BACI双边贸易数据库（1995—2022年，97个产品组），考察引力模型系数与贸易网络拓扑之间的双向Granger因果关系。我们采用三种方法上不同的因果检验方法——传统面板Granger检验、基于Bayes因子的Bayesian模型比较，以及基于Random Forest的变量重要性分析——在考虑潜在非线性的同时建立稳健的方向性关系。一个关键的方法创新是引入分形维数和局部空隙度分布矩（均值、方差、偏度、峰度）作为捕捉多尺度异质性的新网络指标，同时结合传统的中心性和模块化测度。使用基于网络的降维方法（广义网络降维分析），我们识别出两到四个不同的部门与产品时间聚类，这些聚类表现出异质的引力系数动态，并使用Bayesian ARIMA模型将预测延伸至2030年。我们的结果揭示了网络结构属性与引力系数之间存在显著的Granger因果关系，但三种方法在检测到的结构数量上差异显著：Random Forest方法识别出的部门层面和产品层面显著关系比两种线性方法多三到四倍。在总体层面，中心化测度和异质性指标（空隙度、分形维数）在各部门和产品中广泛且一致地Granger先于GDP弹性，而其与距离弹性的关系则集中于特定部门和产品组，而非在总体网络中一致发挥作用。距离弹性在研究期内于总体层面表现出幅度下降，但产品组之间仍存在显著异质性，一些聚类表现出稳定甚至上升的距离敏感性。跨数据库三角验证确认，这些模式在替代性贸易流概念化（总贸易与增加值贸易）下均保持稳健。这些发现从三个方面对国际贸易理论作出贡献。第一，它们提供了时间先后的系统性证据——通过Granger式检验而非结构因果识别建立——表明由网络拓扑捕捉的贸易广延边际持续领先于引力系数所反映的集约边际，这与异质性企业模型的预测一致，即企业的进入/退出决策在总体贸易量调整之前重塑网络结构。第二，也是最稳健的，所记录的部门层面异质性为“距离之谜”提供了结构性解释：ICT和服务部门通过网络去中心化表现出真实的距离压缩，而重制造业则通过持续的区域模块化维持地理约束。第三，网络脆弱性指标对引力系数的Granger因果先行性，在生产网络冲击传播文献与引力框架之间建立了实证桥梁，对理解地缘政治碎片化背景下的供应链韧性具有直接相关性。
title: Is the World Getting Smaller? Network‐Driven Heterogeneity in Gravity‐Model Elasticities
title_zh: 世界正在变小吗？引力模型弹性中的网络驱动异质性

abstract: Waste-to-energy (WtE) incineration is increasingly promoted as a solution to municipal solid waste management and low-carbon energy generation. However, their deployment raises growing concerns about ecological degradation. This study examines the effects of WtE plants on bird species richness and environmental pollution in China. Using a difference-in-differences (DID) framework and a city-level panel dataset from 2010 to 2024, we conduct heterogeneity analysis, and our results show that biodiversity losses are 9.7% lower around high-capacity WtE facilities compared to low-capacity ones, and 8.7% lower around high-power-generation plants relative to low-power ones. By integrating bird species richness data with vegetation indices and air pollution metrics, we demonstrate that biodiversity loss is primarily driven by environmental degradation linked to WtE operation. Moreover, we employ instrumental variable (IV) strategies to reduce potential endogeneity. We use Double Machine Learning (DML) approaches and county-level regressions as robustness checks. Our findings call for advancement in WtE technologies and retrofit of outdated facilities to improve environmental performance, alongside strategic spatial planning that situates plants in less populated areas with strong transportation networks to balance ecological protection and operational sustainability.
abstract_zh: 垃圾焚烧发电（WtE）日益被视为城市固体废物管理和低碳能源生产的解决方案。然而，其部署引发了人们对生态退化的日益担忧。本研究考察了WtE电厂对中国鸟类物种丰富度和环境污染的影响。我们采用双重差分（DID）框架和2010年至2024年的城市面板数据集，进行异质性分析，结果表明：与低容量WtE设施相比，高容量WtE设施周边的生物多样性损失低9.7%；与低发电量电厂相比，高发电量电厂周边的生物多样性损失低8.7%。通过将鸟类物种丰富度数据与植被指数和空气污染指标相结合，我们证明生物多样性损失主要由与WtE运营相关的环境退化所驱动。此外，我们采用工具变量（IV）策略以减少潜在的内生性。我们使用双重机器学习（DML）方法和县级回归作为稳健性检验。我们的发现呼吁推进WtE技术并改造老旧设施以改善环境绩效，同时进行战略性空间规划，将电厂选址于人口较少且交通网络发达的地区，以平衡生态保护与运营可持续性。

abstract: Transportation networks often radiate from national capitals, reflecting political priorities as much as economic logic. How costly is infrastructure built for politics rather than markets? We study China’s Grand Canal: when the Mongols moved the capital from the central plain to Beijing, the canal followed, bypassing the economic core it once served. Using a grid-year panel spanning five dynasties (8th–19th centuries), we show the route best suited to reach the capital predicts the canal’s actual path. This redesign reshaped market access and, through it, population. Counterfactual analysis shows the canal raised population by 2.5–6.1%, but its politically motivated redesign cost 1.1–2.2%.
abstract_zh: 交通网络往往从国家首都向外辐射，既反映政治优先事项，也反映经济逻辑。为政治而非市场建设基础设施的代价有多大？我们研究中国的京杭大运河：当蒙古人将首都从中原迁至北京时，运河也随之改道，绕开了它曾经服务的经济核心区。利用跨越五个朝代（8至19世纪）的网格—年份面板数据，我们表明，最适合通往首都的路线能够预测运河的实际路径。这一重新设计重塑了市场可达性，并由此影响了人口。反事实分析显示，运河使人口增加了2.5%至6.1%，但其出于政治动机的重新设计造成了1.1%至2.2%的损失。

abstract: We study how property rights over land, capital, and output interact with cultural transmission to determine the welfare of the elderly. In our model, respect for the elderly emerges endogenously: adults transmit norms of care to children, which children later reciprocate when they become adults. We compare regimes of insecure rights over produced goods with secure rights over productive resources, showing that both can sustain elderly well-being through distinct channels. By distinguishing between property rights to outputs and to inputs—and further between fixed and created resources—we uncover nonlinear interactions between cultural transmission, property institutions, and production technologies, and a general curvilinear pattern where the elderly are relatively better off compared to the middle-aged in either an insecure property right (i.e., common resources) regime or a high productive property rights regime relative to intermediate cases. Ethnographic evidence illustrates these mechanisms and helps explain cross-societal variation in elderly support. The model also demonstrates how demographic, technological, and policy changes can alter the conditions for elderly well-being across stages of development.
abstract_zh: 我们研究土地、资本和产出的产权如何与文化传承相互作用，以决定老年人的福利。在我们的模型中，对老年人的尊重是内生出现的：成年人向儿童传递照护规范，儿童日后成为成年人时再予以回报。我们比较了对所生产物品权利不安全的制度与对生产性资源权利安全的制度，表明二者都能通过不同渠道维持老年人的福祉。通过区分产出产权与投入产权——并进一步区分固定资源与创造资源——我们揭示了文化传承、产权制度与生产技术之间的非线性互动，以及一种总体上的曲线型模式：相对于中间情形，在产权不安全（即共有资源）制度下，或在高生产性产权制度下，老年人相对于中年人境况相对更好。民族志证据说明了这些机制，并有助于解释老年人支持方面的跨社会差异。该模型还表明，人口、技术和政策变化如何能够在不同发展阶段改变老年人福祉的条件。

abstract: The 2026 Middle East conflict and the disruption of traffic through the Strait of Hormuz generated the largest physical supply disruption in the history of global energy markets. This column examines why energy prices rose by less than the loss of physical supply alone would have suggested. High inventories, emergency stock releases, rerouting, and demand compression have bought time. The key policy question is how long these buffers can continue to absorb the shock.
abstract_zh: 2026年中东冲突及霍尔木兹海峡交通中断，造成了全球能源市场历史上最大规模的实物供应中断。本专栏探讨了为何能源价格的上涨幅度小于仅凭实物供应损失所应有的水平。高库存、紧急库存释放、改道运输以及需求压缩争取了时间。关键的政策问题是，这些缓冲还能在多长时间内继续吸收冲击。

title: Energy markets under chokepoint stress: The 2026 Hormuz shock

abstract: High-growth startups often lose money before they make it. This column examines whether differences in financing capacity are reflected in the cash flow and growth trajectories of startups in Sweden, where US and non-US venture capitalists invest in the same institutional environment. The authors find that US VC-backed Swedish startups experience deeper operating losses, receive more follow-on capital, and achieve higher subsequent sales. The test for the Scaleup Europe Fund, intended to support growth-stage investments of €100 million or more, is whether it mobilises additional private capital and provides credible continuity of finance, not simply whether it deploys its initial commitment.
abstract_zh: 高增长初创企业往往在盈利之前先经历亏损。本专栏考察了融资能力差异是否反映在瑞典初创企业的现金流和增长轨迹中，而在瑞典，美国和非美国风险投资家是在相同的制度环境下进行投资的。作者发现，由美国风险资本支持的瑞典初创企业会经历更深的经营亏损，获得更多后续资本，并在随后实现更高的销售额。对旨在支持1亿欧元及以上成长期投资的Scaleup Europe Fund而言，检验标准在于它是否能动员额外的私人资本并提供可信的融资连续性，而不仅仅是它是否部署了初始承诺资金。
authors: Thomas F Hellmann, Alexander Montag, Joacim Tåg
title: Financing the startup J-curve
title_zh: 为初创企业的J曲线融资

abstract: Global current account imbalances are widening again. This column argues that currency undervaluation, supported by reserve accumulation under capital controls, can permanently reshape industrial structure and raise manufacturing productivity. Panel evidence from 45 countries shows that this policy mix expands manufacturing employment, firm entry, and domestic sourcing of intermediate inputs. A model with firm dynamics and trade hysteresis explains why: sustained exchange rate policy can induce firm entry and exit, reallocating firms across countries and expanding the domestic capture of supply chains. The effect of the policy on the trading partner hinges on whether foreign firms are pushed to exit.
abstract_zh: 全球经常账户失衡再次扩大。本专栏认为，在资本管制下通过储备积累所支撑的货币低估，能够永久性地重塑产业结构并提高制造业生产率。来自45个国家的面板证据表明，这一政策组合扩大了制造业就业、企业进入以及中间投入品的国内采购。一个包含企业动态与贸易迟滞的模型解释了其原因：持续的汇率政策能够引致企业进入与退出，在国家间重新配置企业，并扩大供应链的国内捕获。该政策对贸易伙伴的影响取决于外国企业是否被挤出。
authors: Paul Bergin, Woo Jin Choi, Ju Hyun Pyun

abstract: Motivated by the problem of assigning mediators to cases in the Kenyan judicial system, this paper studies an online resource allocation problem where incoming tasks (cases) must be immediately assigned to available, capacity-constrained resources (mediators). The resources differ in their quality, which may need to be learned. In addition, resources can only be assigned to a subset of tasks that overlaps to varying degrees with the subset of tasks to which other resources can be assigned. The objective is to maximize task completion while satisfying soft capacity constraints across all the resources. The scale of the real-world problem poses substantial challenges, since there are more than 2,000 mediators and a multitude of combinations of geographic locations (87) and case types (12) on which each mediator is qualified to work. Together, these features—unknown quality of new resources (newly onboarded mediators), soft capacity constraints (due to the mandate to assign cases without delay), and high-dimensional state space—make existing scheduling and resource allocation algorithms either inapplicable or inefficient. The paper formalizes the problem in a tractable manner, using a quadratic program formulation for assignment and a multi-agent bandit-style framework for learning. The paper demonstrates the key properties and advantages of the new algorithm, SMaRT (Selecting Mediators that are Right for the Task), compared with baselines on some stylized instances of the mediator allocation problem. The paper then turns to considering its application to real-world data on cases and mediators from the Kenyan judiciary. SMaRT outperforms baselines and allows for controlling the tradeoff between the strictness of the capacity constraints and overall case resolution rates, both in situations where mediator quality is known beforehand and when the problem is bandit-like in that learning is part of the problem definition. On the strength of these results, the study plans to conduct a randomized controlled trial that will deploy SMaRT in the judiciary’s mediation management system.

abstract: Tax exemptions for basic items exist worldwide, typically justified by governments as a way to reduce the cost of living for poorer households. This paper studies the unanticipated removal of consumption taxes on selected food items in Papua New Guinea. It conducts a difference-in-differences analysis using administrative data, a supermarket price census, web-scraped online prices, and a nationally representative household phone survey panel. The findings show complete pass-through in formal supermarkets in central urban districts, where retail competition is strong, but no pass-through in informal stores or rural areas, where poorer households mainly shop. Only 16 percent of the foregone revenue accrued to the poorest two quintiles, while the richest two quintiles and stores/wholesalers each captured almost 40 percent of the benefits. This degree of regressivity and variation in pass-through was unanticipated by 237 experts who participated in a prediction survey. Using a static marginal value of public funds–style comparison, the paper shows that universal cash transfers would generate roughly two and a half times as much quintile-weighted value per fiscal dollar as the tax exemption. The findings demonstrate that food tax exemptions are inherently regressive in lower-income settings, due to high informality, substantial market segmentation, and positive income elasticity of demand for basic food.
abstract_zh: 基本商品的税收豁免在世界范围内普遍存在，各国政府通常将其作为降低较贫困家庭生活成本的一种方式。本文研究了巴布亚新几内亚对部分食品取消消费税这一未预期政策。研究使用行政数据、超市价格普查、网络爬取的在线价格以及具有全国代表性的家庭电话调查面板，进行了双重差分分析。研究发现，在零售竞争激烈的中心城区正规超市中，税收取消实现了完全传导，但在较贫困家庭主要购物的非正规商店或农村地区则没有传导。只有16%的税收收入损失流向了最贫困的两个五分位群体，而最富裕的两个五分位群体以及商店/批发商各自获得了近40%的收益。这种累退程度以及传导差异，是参与预测调查的237位专家所未预料到的。通过静态公共资金边际价值式比较，本文表明，普遍现金转移每财政美元所产生的五分位加权价值约为税收豁免的2.5倍。研究结果表明，在低收入环境中，由于非正规性高、市场分割严重以及基本食品需求具有正收入弹性，食品税收豁免本质上具有累退性。

abstract: Over March-May 2026, the world faced what was defined as “the biggest energy crisis in history.” How did countries respond to such challenge? To what extent were social protection systems scaled up, and if not so, why? The paper offers three main contributions: it codifies global social protection responses in 2026 and compares them to measures mitigating economic crises in 2008, 2020, and 2022; it helps interpret responses through a novel, stylized crisis response framework, including explaining choices around “if” and “how” to respond; and it sets out four illustrative reform scenarios for making social protection more crisis ready. The paper argues that for crisis scalability to gain more policy traction, it must be communicated and devised as an effort to prepare seriously, scale up temporarily, and scale down credibly.
abstract_zh: 2026年3月至5月，世界面临被定义为“历史上最大能源危机”的局面。各国如何应对这一挑战？社会保护体系在多大程度上得到扩展？若未能扩展，原因何在？本文有三项主要贡献：第一，系统梳理2026年全球社会保护应对措施，并将其与2008年、2020年和2022年缓解经济危机的措施进行比较；第二，通过一个新颖的、程式化的危机应对框架帮助解读这些应对措施，包括解释围绕“是否”以及“如何”应对所作的选择；第三，提出四种示意性改革情景，以使社会保护体系更具危机应对能力。本文认为，要使危机可扩展性获得更多政策牵引力，就必须将其传播和设计为一项认真准备、临时扩展、可信缩减的努力。

abstract: The generational evolution of gender gaps in education in Sub-Saharan Africa remains poorly documented at the regional scale. This paper uses micro data from Demographic and Health Surveys and Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys from 35 countries (approximately 736,000 individuals), complemented by international educational assessment and monitoring program (managed by the Conference of Ministers of Education of French-Speaking Countries) test scores for 14 francophone countries. The paper traces gender differences in educational attainment and learning by birth cohort. The findings show that attainment gaps narrow sharply across cohorts: the female disadvantage falls from 13–15 percentage points in primary and secondary attendance and 1.9 years of schooling among those born in the 1970s to far smaller values among the most recent cohorts, and it is statistically insignificant across most of the youngest birth cohorts. Among those born after 1999, females exceed males in secondary attendance and years of education in a majority of countries. However, convergence is uneven. It partly reflects stagnation in boys’ secondary attendance rather than female gains; learning gaps show no uniform direction across countries and often run counter to attainment; and wider attainment gaps persist among rural, poorer, and Muslim populations.
abstract_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲教育性别差距的代际演变在区域层面仍缺乏充分记录。本文使用来自35个国家（约736000人）的人口与健康调查及多指标类集调查微观数据，并辅以14个法语国家的国际教育评估与监测项目（由法语国家教育部长会议管理）测试成绩。本文按出生队列追踪教育获得与学习方面的性别差异。研究发现，教育获得差距在各队列间显著缩小：在20世纪70年代出生的人群中，女性在小学和中学入学率上分别落后13—15个百分点，受教育年限少1.9年，而在最近队列中这些劣势降至远小得多的数值，并且在大多数最年轻出生队列中在统计上不显著。在1999年以后出生的人群中，大多数国家女性的中学入学率和受教育年限超过男性。然而，趋同并不均衡。这在一定程度上反映的是男孩中学入学率停滞，而非女性进步；学习差距在各国之间没有一致方向，且往往与教育获得情况相反；在农村、较贫困和穆斯林人群中，教育获得差距仍然更大。

abstract: Despite heightened interest in the role of geopolitics and fragmentation for cross-border economic activity, there is limited understanding of the potential scarring effects of adverse global conditions on foreign direct investment (FDI). Accounting for the real-time nature of investor decisions, local projection estimates show that adverse global growth shocks have scarring effects on FDI project announcements for about three years. Beyond the baseline finding, the paper offers three novel results: scarring effects are more subdued in “safe” countries; projects in “strategic” sectors smooth headline announcement fluctuations because they are less sensitive to adverse global growth shocks; and geopolitical positioning plays an important role in the uneven recovery of FDI announcements. The results are robust to a variety of additional exercises, including sample adjustments, alternative shock measures and specifications, and various definitions of institutions, sectors, and geopolitical alignment.
abstract_zh: 尽管地缘政治与碎片化对跨境经济活动的作用日益受到关注，但关于不利全球条件对外国直接投资（FDI）可能造成的疤痕效应，现有理解仍较为有限。考虑到投资者决策的实时性，局部投影估计显示，不利的全球增长冲击会对FDI项目公告产生约三年的疤痕效应。在基准发现之外，本文提供了三项新结果：疤痕效应在“安全”国家更为温和；由于“战略”部门的项目对不利全球增长冲击不那么敏感，因而能够平滑总体公告波动；地缘政治定位在FDI公告的不均衡复苏中发挥重要作用。上述结果在多种额外检验中均保持稳健，包括样本调整、替代性冲击度量与设定，以及制度、部门和地缘政治阵营的各种定义。

abstract: Emigration continues to shape the demographic and economic landscapes of Pacific Island Countries (PICs), though patterns and impacts vary widely across the region. This paper examines emigration trends in PICs and their implications on human capital and growth. We find that traditional emigration, which is largely characterized by a permanent relocation of young, highly skilled individuals—primarily to Australia and New Zealand—results in a brain drain in home countries. Moreover, many of these emigrants work in low-skilled jobs abroad, indicating significant skill mismatches and limited skill acquisition. More recent emigration has been driven by the expansion of labor mobility arrangements (LMAs) in Australia and New Zealand, involving low-skilled young workers who typically return home. These LMAs offer opportunities to mitigate brain drain, reduce youth unemployment, and support near-term economic growth through remittances. At the same time, children of LMA workers are more likely to drop out of school, thus undermining human capital accumulation and limiting long-term output gains. From a policy perspective, the results suggest that temporary labor mobility can be a helpful development instrument, while complementary policies are needed to safeguard children’s education, promote the productive use of remittances, and strengthen skills development and job creation at home.
abstract_zh: 移民持续塑造着太平洋岛国（PICs）的人口与经济格局，尽管该地区各国的移民模式及其影响差异显著。本文考察太平洋岛国的移民趋势及其对人力资本和增长的影响。我们发现，传统移民主要以年轻、高技能个体的永久迁移为特征——主要迁往澳大利亚和新西兰——导致母国出现人才外流。此外，这些移民中许多人在国外从事低技能工作，表明存在显著的技能错配和有限的技能获取。较近期的移民则由澳大利亚和新西兰劳动力流动安排（LMAs）的扩展所驱动，涉及通常回国的低技能年轻工人。这些劳动力流动安排为缓解人才外流、降低青年失业率以及通过汇款支持近期经济增长提供了机会。与此同时，劳动力流动安排工人的子女更有可能辍学，从而削弱人力资本积累并限制长期产出收益。从政策角度看，结果表明临时劳动力流动可以成为一种有益的发展工具，同时需要配套政策以保障儿童教育、促进汇款的生产性使用，并加强母国的技能发展和就业创造。
title: From Departure to Development: How Emigration Shapes Human Capital and Growth in Pacific Island Countries
title_zh: 从离境到发展：移民如何塑造太平洋岛国的人力资本与增长

abstract: We provide evidence that education contributed to England’s Industrial Revolution by increasing upper-tail human capital. Contrary to the prevailing view that schooling was irrelevant to early industrialization, we show that the expansion of schooling lowered barriers to entering apprenticeships in skill-intensive trades. We introduce new parish-level data on 3,000 school foundations, 46,000 charitable bequests, and 350,000 apprenticeship contracts between 1711 and 1805. Using a staggered difference-in-differences design exploiting educational endowments through wills, we show that the expansion of schooling increased apprenticeship training, particularly in occupations requiring reading, writing, and mathematical skills that were crucial for the Industrial Revolution.
abstract_zh: 我们提供的证据表明，教育通过提升高端人力资本，对英格兰工业革命作出了贡献。与认为学校教育在早期工业化中无关紧要的主流观点相反，我们表明学校教育的扩张降低了进入技能密集型行业学徒制的门槛。我们引入了关于1711年至1805年间3000所学校基金会、46000份慈善遗赠和350000份学徒合同的新教区级数据。利用交错双重差分设计，并通过遗嘱中的教育捐赠来识别，我们表明学校教育的扩张增加了学徒培训，尤其是在需要阅读、写作和数学技能的职业中，而这些技能对工业革命至关重要。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为英格兰第一次工业革命时期的教育与学徒制，数据与制度背景均为英国，与中国无关。
title: Education and Skills During the First Industrial Revolution in England
title_zh: 英格兰第一次工业革命时期的教育与技能

abstract: This paper distinguishes between two types of crises that appear similar but differ fundamentally in their underlying mechanisms: fire-sale crises, where productive firms are forced to sell assets; and demand-freeze crises, where productive firms are unable to purchase assets. While both lead to similar observable outcomes, they have contrasting general equilibrium effects and may call for different policy interventions. Notably, conventional policies can be counterproductive in demand-freeze crises, as they may exacerbate financial constraints and further distort resource allocation. Empirical evidence on the pattern of capital reallocation among U.S. firms suggests that demand-freeze crises are, in fact, more common.
abstract_zh: 本文区分了两种表面上相似但在内在机制上存在根本差异的危机：贱卖危机，即生产性企业被迫出售资产；以及需求冻结危机，即生产性企业无法购买资产。尽管二者导致的可观察结果相似，但它们具有截然不同的一般均衡效应，并可能需要不同的政策干预。值得注意的是，传统政策在需求冻结危机中可能适得其反，因为它们可能加剧金融约束并进一步扭曲资源配置。关于美国企业间资本再配置模式的实证证据表明，需求冻结危机实际上更为常见。
title: Frost and Fire: A Tale of Two Crises
title_zh: 霜与火：两种危机的故事

abstract: This article uses inflation expectations to investigate the mechanisms that linked supply and demand shocks to inflation outcomes during 2021-24. It describes several theoretical mechanisms through which shocks led to inflation, highlighting the role of expectations in this process. It uses multiple sources of expectations data for the US, EA, and UK to evaluate each of these channels. Finally, it surveys the literature that has used expectations data to make sense of the 2021-24 inflation surge. The article applies the results from this investigation to assess how well anchored inflation expectations were during the surge and at the end of it.
abstract_zh: 本文利用通胀预期考察2021—2024年间供给与需求冲击同通胀结果相联系的机制。文章描述了冲击导致通胀的若干理论机制，并强调预期在这一过程中的作用。文章使用美国、欧元区和英国的多种预期数据来源，对上述各渠道逐一评估。最后，文章综述了利用预期数据解释2021—2024年通胀飙升的文献。文章将这一考察的结果用于评估通胀飙升期间及其结束时通胀预期的锚定程度。
title: Why did Inflation Rise and Fall in 2021-24? Channels and Evidence from Expectations
title_zh: 2021-24年通胀为何先升后降？来自预期的渠道与证据

abstract: This paper studies how digital infrastructure is associated with the spatial structure of international trade in goods. We embed data availability into a structural gravity framework, conceptualizing it as an information friction that interacts with geographic distance and equilibrium market access. Using the topology of the global subsea cable network, we construct country-level measures of digital network position. We find that countries with greater digital network embeddedness, particularly on the exporter side, exhibit lower distance elasticities of trade. Other dimensions of digital connectivity are more closely associated with multilateral resistance, highlighting distinct channels through which digital infrastructure affects goods trade.
abstract_zh: 本文研究数字基础设施如何与国际贸易商品的空间结构相关联。我们将数据可得性嵌入结构引力框架，将其概念化为一种与地理距离和均衡市场准入相互作用的信息摩擦。利用全球海底光缆网络的拓扑结构，我们构建了国家层面的数字网络位置指标。我们发现，数字网络嵌入程度更高的国家，尤其是在出口方一侧，其贸易的距离弹性更低。数字连通性的其他维度则与多边阻力关联更为紧密，凸显了数字基础设施影响商品贸易的不同渠道。
